description_en: Associates a bandwidth plan for application acceleration with a Smart Access Gateway (SAG) instance
description_zh: 绑定应用加速带宽包和智能接入网关实例
kebab_example: aliyun smartag associate-smart-ag-with-application-bandwidth-package --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --application-bandwidth-package-id abwp-7963l7iqnquyj30000 --associate-configs Bandwidth=2 SmartAGId=sag-gf5serujbhrn2j0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AssociateSmartAGWithApplicationBandwidthPackage

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to precheck the request. Check items include permissions and the status of the specified cloud resources. Valid values:

false (default): sends the request. After the request passes the check, the bandwidth plan for application acceleration is associated with the SAG instance.
true: prechecks the request but does not associate the bandwidth plan for application acceleration with the SAG instance. If you use this value, the system checks the required parameters and the request syntax. If the request fails the precheck, an error message is returned. If the request passes the precheck, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned
parameters.help_zh:
是否对此次绑定请求执行预检，包括权限、实例状态校验等。取值：

false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接绑定应用加速带宽包和智能接入网关实例。
true：发送检查请求，只进行校验，不会绑定应用加速带宽包和智能接入网关实例。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式等。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the value, but you must make sure that it is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not set this parameter, ClientToken is set to the value of RequestId. The value of RequestId for each API request may be different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:

parameters.help_zh:
应用加速带宽包所属地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

fields.help_en:
The maximum bandwidth value for application acceleration. Unit: Mbit/s.

The maximum bandwidth value of each SAG instance cannot exceed that of the associated bandwidth plan for application acceleration
fields.help_zh:
智能接入网关实例的应用加速带宽峰值。单位：Mbps。

每个智能接入网关实例的应用加速带宽峰值不能超过其绑定的应用加速带宽包的带宽峰值
